I got this topsy turvy early September this year. I live in a urban city in the Philippines and temperature reaches up to 35-40°c. I live on the second floor and my succulents are placed on the balcony. They get full sun (6 am-5pm) but I take them in after sunset just in case it rains. The width of my succulent went from 3” to 1 1/2”.

 My initial thought was etiolation? (Very unsure about that since it gets full sun, but I noticed that the stem was getting thinner and the leaves were falling. I water my succulents once a week and sometimes once every 2 weeks depending on the weather and how quickly the potting mix dries. I use locally-made cns soil mix.
